data_compatibility.paper_preprocessing: Scanned grayscale; high-intensity pixels set to white. Images are not centered, size normalized, or rotated; lower resolution uses OpenCV.
data_compatibility.prospective_requirement: A source adapter and polarity/range/preprocessing rule must be frozen from documentation and old development before new-source model access. Do not select transforms by fresh-source accuracy. This is a domain shift from QMNIST.

execution_scope.network: Read-only unauthenticated public HTTPS; initial sandbox-denied request retained, normal reviewed public GETs then succeeded.

files.download_confirmation: The public Drive form was followed only for a Range bytes=0-127 header request; no authentication or full-array download.
files.name: Images(28x28).npy

future_fresh_split_power.constraint: Any calibration, development, qualification, and final confirmation split consumes the same 97 source-local groups; a split cannot simultaneously give every role 97 fresh groups.
future_fresh_split_power.independence_unit: writer; 14 digit repetitions or multiple views do not create additional independent writer groups
future_fresh_split_power.interpretation: Even all 97 writers cannot alone establish the registered 0.004999 false-accept bound under that illustrative one-trial-per-writer IID model. HWD+ does not replace separately designed missing-request/OOD evidence. Grouped efficacy and calibration precision need prospective power assessment after the intended effect and split are specified; this review supplies no power claim.
future_fresh_split_power.split_status: No roles, IDs, seeds, or counts assigned; candidate remains untouched by any model.

license.author_use_statement: Publicly distributed for described research uses; author requests citation of the corresponding paper.
license.formal_dataset_license: None according to author Datasheet section 6 Distribution

next_stage_requirements_if_parent_regist: Fix rights/use scope and attribution; do not upload the raw arrays as if openly licensed.
Freeze exact full-array hashes, validate shape/row correspondence and writer/digit counts without model scoring.
Register source-local writer-disjoint roles, all preprocessing, repeated-clip alias rules, estimands, tests, and power limits before fresh predictions.
Keep the current frozen model, all qualification failures, and 85-writer confirmation unchanged.
scope: Prospective-source metadata feasibility only. No current registration, model, calibration, candidate, qualification, allocation, or confirmation change.
status: Author-linked public download technically available; credible source-local writer grouping; no formal dataset license; prospective use not allocated or evaluated.

writer_provenance.collection: New volunteer handwriting collected by the first author, standardized paper and pens, anonymous at collection, physical pages associated with writer ID before image extraction.
writer_provenance.grouping_support: The author datasheet explicitly recommends writer-axis splits for most tasks; these IDs are designed to link actual writer replications, unlike unreliable user IDs in an unrelated crowdsourced corpus.
limits: No full WriterInfo values have been aggregated; the 97 unique values and 140 rows per writer are author-reported, not independently recounted in this review.
Authors describe a nonrandom, nonrepresentative volunteer sample.
Anonymous source-local IDs cannot prove that no natural person participated in another anonymous dataset; no re-identification was attempted.
Separate collection provenance and source-local IDs do not by themselves establish statistical independence or population representativeness.
writer_provenance.metadata_minimization: Only Digit and ID would be needed for prospective construction and grouped offline evaluation. Other personal attributes are unnecessary and should not enter the model or matching rule.
writer_provenance.readme_count_discrepancy: ReadMe says 13,350 rows, while actual NPY header is 13,580 x 9, payload length is exactly 128+13580*9*4, and paper/datasheet report 13,580. Retain this documentary discrepancy.
